# Source: SA-REMOTE-TRACKTYPE-001. Static analysis only: no value below was captured from a Remote connection (live_check = unconfirmed).
# The condition column is read from the code (anchors name the rows of logic-remote-trackcolor-anchors.tsv that pin the constants).
# The meaning column is a hypothesis with the stated confidence; it is not a fact.
# For scope ati.t the rule number is the order in which trackTypeForTrack:seqID:ginst:inSong: (0x01693e90) tries the rules; the first that applies wins.
# Terms: G = the "ginst object" FUN_01a15c7c(song, ginst) returns (only for a strip whose type byte +0x69 is 0x11), kind(G) = ushort at G[0] with bit 3 cleared;
#        entry = the 0x50-byte track entry (kind byte +0x10, depth byte +0x12, flags +0x14, id +0x20); strip type = byte +0x69 of the strip the entry's id selects.

column4: entry known and FUN_019fa680 is true (entry kind not 3, 4, 5, 0xc; the next entry that is not kind 5 or 0xc is exactly one level deeper) and entry[+0x14] & 0x40
column6: a track with children that is not a kind-3/4 container; flag 0x40 distinguishes it from 8

column4: same as 7 with the flag clear; also the fall-back when the parent branch cannot finish (sequence flagged invalid, entry outside the range, depth mismatch)

entry known and its kind is 4 (an entry of kind 0xc takes the kind of the nearest preceding entry that is not 0xc or 5); also an entry of kind 3 that has a deeper next entry and whose parent entry has kind 4
column6: a folder-like container (entry kind 4); the default colour index 76 of key 3 is not shared with other kinds
